eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Siskiyou, CA; at 8:12 PM on AUG 25, 2025 Effective until 4:12 AM AUG 26, 2025. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Siskiyou County Sheriffs Office has issued an EVACUATION ORDER for Zone 1506 in the area of Ti-Bar Rd due to Dillon Fire. Anyone in this area is ordered to leave now.
